summary_1line: Both armies finalize their formations at dawn as ominous portents appear and Sanjaya describes the positions and leaders of the Kaurava and Pandava forces.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna's chariot rises above the battlefield with a gigantic ape banner towering over all other standards.
Bhima whirls his massive iron mace at the head of advancing troops while thousands of soldiers and elephants surge behind him.
At dawn the two vast armies face each other under a dust-darkened sky as meteors fall and the trembling earth cracks beneath them.
